title: He Tried to Speedrun a Tree 🌱 | Sam & Layla Ep. 1
description:
Sam planted a seed yesterday. Why isn't it a tree yet?! 🌱
He yells at it, drowns it, coaches it, sets it on fire (by accident), leaves nature a one-star review, hides in a bush, guards it all night... but Layla knows the secret.

Sam & Layla is a new stick-figure comedy series. New episodes soon — subscribe so you don't miss episode 2!

0:00 Yelling at dirt
0:50 Plan B: water / Plan C: the coach
1:49 Plan D: plant food / Plan E: music
2:41 Plan F: more sun & the one-star review
3:36 A watched pot never boils
4:25 Operation Don't Look
5:33 The mirror, the string & sunset
7:00 The night watch
8:08 The payoff
9:04 Years later...

Sound effects: original, plus Kenney (kenney.nl, CC0). Music: original.
